redfin.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated townhome in the highly desirable Parkwood community, offering the perfect combination of modern style, comfort, and convenience. The spacious living room welcomes you with soaring vaulted ceilings , abundant natural light , luxury vinyl plank flooring , and a cozy fireplace that serves as the heart of the home. The open floor plan flows effortlessly into the dining area and remodeled kitchen, where you’ll find quartz countertops, contemporary cabinetry, generous counter space, and a functional layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms provide comfortable retreats, while the tastefully remodeled bathrooms feature clean, modern finishes that create a fresh, spa-inspired feel. An in-unit laundry area adds everyday convenience. One of the standout features is the private storage room located directly adjacent to the assigned parking space, providing valuable extra storage rarely found in similar properties. Parkwood residents enjoy a resort-style lifestyle with beautifully maintained grounds, a sparkling pool, relaxing spa, fitness center, and clubhouse. HOA dues also provide the convenience of professionally maintained common areas, allowing for truly low-maintenance living. Ideally situated in the heart of Van Nuys, this home offers easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, public transportation, and major freeways, making commuting throughout the San Fernando Valley and Greater Los Angeles simple and convenient. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer, downsizing, or searching for an excellent investment opportunity, this move-in-ready home delivers exceptional value in one of Van Nuys’ most sought-after townhouse communities. Don’t miss your chance to make it yours!
